#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    long long w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    if (w <= 3) {
        cout << "YES" << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    if (m < 0) {
        cout << "NO" << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    int n = 0;
    long long bases[100];
    for (long long v = 1; v <= 2000000000LL; v *= w) {
        bases[n++] = v;
    }
    int i = 0;
    bool ok = true;
    while (m != 0) {
        if (i >= n) {
            ok = false;
            break;
        }
        long long r = m % w;
        if (r == 0) {
            m /= w;
        } else if (r == 1) {
            m = (m - 1) / w;
        } else if (r == w - 1) {
            m = (m + 1) / w;
        } else {
            ok = false;
            break;
        }
        i++;
    }
    cout << (ok ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
